title: Day 31 — Capstone: URL Shortener
prompt: Two tickets for our URL shortener: same URL shortened twice returns different codes (should be idempotent), and we want custom aliases. Here's the code and its store. Walk me through your plan, then build it.

clarifications.answer: The same URL must always return the same code. store.code_for_url(url) tells you if you've seen it.
shorten(url, alias=...) uses that alias. If the alias already maps to a DIFFERENT url, raise AliasTaken; re-aliasing the same url is fine.
An auto-generated code must not collide with an existing alias — use store.has_code to skip taken codes.
resolve(code) returns the url or None if the code is unknown.
Read store.py: save, get, code_for_url, has_code are the hooks you need.
Change only shortener.py; store.py and the tests are fixed.

hints: Read store.py first — code_for_url (idempotency) and has_code (collision avoidance) are already there.
Bug: before minting a new code, return store.code_for_url(url) if it exists.
Feature: add alias=None; if alias given and maps to a different url -> AliasTaken, else save it; when auto-generating, loop past any code that has_code() already.
